dataset: sp::meuse + sp::meuse.grid — Meuse river flood plain soil samples

checks.dataset_source: sp R package built-in dataset (Pebesma and Bivand, 2005)
checks.dataset_type: Real georeferenced soil samples collected along the Meuse river, Netherlands
checks.crs: Dutch RD New (EPSG:28992), coordinates in meters

expected_geostatistical_output.variogram_model: Spherical or exponential (both common for soil data)
expected_geostatistical_output.moran_statistic: should be significant (p < 0.05) before kriging; residuals should be less autocorrelated after

anti_gaming.score_cap_gates: variogram CSV, predictions CSV, and moran CSV must each be present for score >= 60

screenshot: spatial_kriging_soil_screenshot.png (captured at task start — requires live environment run)
